children: Needham maintained their Buy rating on On Holding's stock with a price target of $40.00.
The price target implies an upside of 36.1% from the Sep 22 close of $29.39.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: On Holding expects to achieve at least 5.6 billion CHF in revenue by FY29, driven by a high-teens constant-FX CAGR, which reflects confidence in its ability to sustain robust growth across core categories and expanding markets.

: The company is strategically entering the global football and golf markets, which, alongside partnerships with high-profile athletes like Kylian Mbappe, is anticipated to enhance brand awareness and drive sales growth over the medium to long term.
